title: Conversational AI Designer (Voice & Chat)
description:
Company Description

A Coru é líder em soluções de experiência de usuário para empresas, focada em desafiar o convencional por meio de sua plataforma inteligente e assistente digital ADI. Oferecemos experiências digitais humanizadas e hiperpersonalizadas, o que aumenta a geração de receita e a eficiência operacional de nossos parceiros.

Mais informações: Coru Website

Job Description

O Conversational AI Designer será responsável por desenhar, construir e otimizar agentes de IA (voz e chat) que interagem com usuários finais em casos de uso financeiros, operacionais e comerciais. É um cargo híbrido entre levantamento de requisitos, design conversacional e construção técnica do agente utilizando ferramentas no-code/low-code como ElevenLabs, ADI e plataformas de voicebots. Sua missão é garantir experiências conversacionais naturais, eficientes e alinhadas ao negócio, trabalhando em conjunto com POs, clientes e equipes técnicas.

Responsabilidades:

1. Discovery e levantamento de requisitos

  • Levantar processos, regras de negócio e necessidades do cliente;
  • Entrevistar stakeholders e mapear os journeys atuais (AS IS);
  • Analisar casos de uso, riscos, cenários críticos e métricas desejadas.

2. Design conversacional (Voz & Chat)

  • Criar fluxos, árvores conversacionais e intents;
  • Definir tom, personalidade e estilo do agente de IA;
  • Redigir diálogos naturais e eficientes (português/espanhol);
  • Estabelecer estratégias de manejo de objeções, quedas e redirecionamentos;
  • Validar a experiência conversacional em diferentes canais (voz, WhatsApp, web);
  • Apoiar equipes internas com ajustes avançados de lógica e estruturação de instruções do agente, garantindo clareza, consistência e eficácia nos comportamentos esperados.

3. Construção do agente

  • Implementar o voicebot/chatbot em ferramentas internas (ADI) ou plataformas equivalentes;
  • Configurar parâmetros, memória, contexto e comportamento do agente;
  • Integrar ElevenLabs para a voz do agente (TTS, sotaques, SSML opcional);
  • Realizar testes end-to-end e ajustar o comportamento com base em métricas reais.

4. Otimização e melhoria contínua

  • Analisar gravações, transcrições e dados de performance;
  • Ajustar instruções, lógica e fluxos para melhorar conversão e CSAT;
  • Garantir qualidade, consistência e cumprimento regulatório (quando aplicável).

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia no desenho de chatbots ou voicebots (mínimo 1 ano).
  • Conhecimento em design de diálogos, UX conversacional e fluxos de decisão.
  • Capacidade de levantar requisitos diretamente com clientes.
  • Excelentes habilidades de redação e comunicação.
  • Espanhol nativo ou avançado + português intermediário (desejável).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA generativa (ChatGPT, LLMs etc.).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com equipes de produto e desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimento de ElevenLabs, Twilio, Dialogflow, Rasa ou similares.
  • Experiência básica com JSON, chamadas de API ou integrações simples.

Você tem o perfil para ser um Coru?

Temos a convicção de que o mais importante de Coru são as pessoas, por isso é fundamental que você faça um “Fit” cultural com toda a equipe. Estes são os pilares da nossa cultura:

-All together: Diversidad de historias y vivencias. Diferentes visiones traen mayores horizontes.

title: Supervisor de Produção
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO

Em modalidade de turno: Responsável pela gestão e atividades relacionadas ao processo produtivo na planta em que atua, supervisionando todas as etapas, provendo recursos e monitorando as necessidades de manutenções, sejam preventivas ou corretivas, atendendo os requisitos de qualidade e concentrando o time em temas e rotinas de segurança. Suportar e prover recursos para a equipe de forma a garantir a eficiência da operação e o atingimento dos resultados operacionais, bem como difundir rotinas de gestão da área cascateadas ao nível de turno como Manutenção Autônoma, requisitos do AMPS (Ardagh Metal Production System) e demais requisitos e acordos repassados pela gerência imediata ou corporação.

Em modalidade administrativa: Responsável pela gestão e atividades da área produtiva, supervisionando processos, rotinas e cumprimentos de padrões, servindo de ponto focal e de apoio ao gerente de produção na propagação de conhecimentos, recursos, desenvolvimentos e monitoramentos necessários para execução das rotinas da área. Suporta também o Gerente de Produção em rotinas administrativas da área como reuniões de planejamentos, demandas corporativas, estratégias de melhoria de resultados e sistema de gestão (AMPS).

RESPONSABILIDADES

Em modalidade de turno:

  • Conhecer, proceder e assegurar que as Políticas da Empresa, no que diz respeito a preservação do meio ambiente, prevenção na gestão de riscos e normas de saúde e segurança do trabalho; qualidade do produto; segurança de alimentos (FSSC 22.000); código de ética; compliance; recursos humanos; missão, visão e valores da empresa, buscando o alinhamento da conduta à estratégia/objetivos estabelecidos da Empresa e garantir que sejam cumpridos pela equipe.
  • Atuar conforme os procedimentos vigentes relacionados a gestão de mudança sendo responsável pelo reporte, divulgação, plano de ação e comunicação junto a equipe.
  • Supervisionar e prover recursos para a execução das rotinas da operação, por meio do monitoramento das manutenções preventivas e corretivas dos equipamentos, controle do volume de produção e tipo de rótulo a ser produzido.
  • Realizar a abertura e fechamento das Ordens de Produção, de Manutenção e consumos de materiais necessários para organização das rotinas produtivas.
  • Tomar decisões relacionadas ao processo produtivo, baseadas em análise de dados técnicos e estatísticos para garantir a assertividade da decisão.
  • Direcionar as ações para minimizar as perdas no processo produtivo, aumentar a eficiência operacional e controlar o consumo de insumos.
  • Garantir a execução dos planos de ação e diretrizes da área na busca do atingimento das metas e resultados operacionais.
  • Supervisionar as atividades de retrabalho de produtos fora de especificação de modo adequá-los ao padrão de qualidade, bem como em processos de repacking.
  • Facilitar a comunicação e disseminação das informações corporativas entre a equipe.
  • Desenvolver tecnicamente a equipe de acordo com a matriz de competência avaliando as necessidades individuais de treinamento e atendendo aos prazos definidos pela corporação.
  • Realizar a avaliação de desempenho da equipe, dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, mapeamento as forças e oportunidades de cada colaborador para elaboração do plano de desenvolvimento individual e retenção de talentos.
  • Realizar feedbacks, promovendo o desenvolvimento de cada colaborador em alinhamento às estratégias e valores da empresa.
  • Executar atividades técnicas e administrativas ligadas a gestão de pessoas, tais como: recrutamento e seleção, integração de novos colaboradores, plano e controle de execução dos treinamentos, ajuste do ponto eletrônico, planejamento de férias, medidas disciplinares e desligamento.
  • Promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável para o engajamento da equipe e melhores resultados.
  • Praticar o conceito de “Melhoria Contínua” no processo, implementando melhorias de segurança e qualidade, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir as práticas de housekeeping.
  • Atuar no AMPS (Ardagh Metal Production System) liderando equipes e grupos internos em todas as iniciativas necessárias conformes demandas da gerência imediata ou corporativa.
  • Comunicar a gerência imediata qualquer problema que ocorra no processo produtivo, bem como seguir o fluxo de comunicação definido na planta para envolvimento de outras áreas, quando necessário e aplicável.
  • Comunicar, treinar, acompanhar e tratar quaisquer questões de segurança do time e da área, a fim de preservar integridade física dos colaboradores e aderência do time operacional à cultura e iniciativas na área de EHS.
  • Disponibilizar e gerenciar recursos como gestões visuais, ferramentas e outros juntamente com o time operacional afim de garantir que se mantenha disponibilizado e em bom estado de conservação todos os recursos disponibilizados para correta execução das atividades.
  • Analisar e montar plano estratégico em caso de desvios de resultados de produção, qualidade, segurança e manutenção, apresentando em reuniões solicitadas e acompanhando o ciclo para garantir correto cumprimento de ações estabelecidadas, por si ou por outros.

Em modalidade administrativa, além de saber realizar e monitorar os mencionados acima para turno, deve:

  • Monitorar o plano de produção, a fim de conciliar as demandas corporativas para atendimento ao cliente com as necessidades locais da planta, montando estratégias de atendimento por módulo e por tipos de produto.
  • Realizar gestões de rotinas, criando e acompanhando indicadores a fim de suportar a execução das rotinas operacionais pelos times operacionais de turno de maneira correta, conforme padrões estabelecidos para cada atividade.
  • Suportar o gerente de produção, por sua solicitação ou ausência, em rotinas administrativas como reuniões corporativas e locais, demandas pontuais ou rotineiras, seja nos temas de segurança, qualidade, produção, manutenção, rh, bem como qualquer outro tema definido que alinhe a área aos requisitos definidos pela organização.
  • Realizar a gestão de KPIs da área já definidos pela companhia visando atingimento de metas e resultados.
  • Ser um facilitador de informações e conhecimento na área, treinando ou suportando os supervisores de turno envolvendo a todos nos temas necessários para a área produtiva.
  • Realizar trabalhos/análises estratégicas para a área, de forma mais abrangente e sistêmica comparando ao supervisor de turno, visando melhoria de resultados e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Auxiliar o Gerente de Produção na condução da Manutenção Autônoma na área produtiva.
  • Participar da implementação de Trials da área, quando solicitado, e repassar informações e direcionamentos aos turnos.
  • Liderar projetos na área produtiva, sejam esses definidos pela gerência local ou corporativa. Ex.: Plant of the Future (PoF).
  • Garantir que as rotinas de reuniões da área produtiva ocorram com o envolvimento correto das pessoas necessárias para boa condução e atingimento dos objetivos.

Formação

Superior completo

Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

  • Pacote Office;
  • Liderança de Equipes (com experiência prévia);
  • Análise e Interpretação de Dados;
  • Conhecimento em indicadores de performance (Produção e Manutenção);
  • Conhecimento e habilidade com processos produtivos;
  • Conhecimento em auditorias e processos de certificações;
  • Habilidade de interpretação e consulta dos manuais técnicos dos equipamentos.
  • Sistemas ERP: SAP;
  • Lean Manufacturing / TPM / WCM ou correlatos;
  • Conhecimento em processos de Estampagem / Corte e repuxo (Prensas);
  • Idioma: Inglês Intermediário ou Avançado.

Sobre a Ardagh:

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!

Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.

Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)

Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.

API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.

Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.

Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.

title: Senior Murex Integration Specialist (S4C)
description:
Project Description:

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.

Whether you possess a background in finance, technology or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.

Responsibilities:

- Must know the following technologies: MxMLExchange, RTBS/MDCS, Datamart

- Knowledge and hands on experience in implementing, developing and supporting various MX.3 proprietary modules for Enterprise Integration such as MxML Exchange, Datamart, MX.3 Accessibility and Extensibility APIs (.Net, Java, C++, and SOAP/REST Web services), Real-time bridging service, Market Data Cache Server, MX.3 Connectivity 2.0 framework, MX.3 Packaged interfaces including (but not limited to) MarkitWire, DTCC Global Trade Repository, MarginSphere, IceLink, FXAll, Market Data Import Tool etc., MX.3 End of Day processes and Trade Life Cycle Management using workflows engine. (At least 3 years)

- Build new up / down stream integration(s)

- Convert existing integration point with Murex version change

- Development of MxML (Workflows, Exchange)

- XSL / Transformation

- Scripting (bsh, ksh, ...etc.)

- Assist existing support group(s) in resolving integration related request or issues

- Contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

- Liaise with technical team(s) -- when needed -- to resolve environment related issues and necessary enhancements in preparation for cloud deployment

- Analyze, formulate, proposed, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

1. Provide professional services to Murex clients:

o Provide services in the domain of system integration, business intelligence and data flows through the full lifecycle of the MX.3: requirements analysis, configuration build, installation, training, upgrade, and production support.

o Professionally interact with Murex colleagues and clients.

2. Build, test, and provide support to clients on MX.3 integration modules.

o Contribute to project implementations

 Participate in design, build, and test phases sometimes remotely and other times at the client site as needed.

 Develop trade workflows and interfaces to set up communication between external platforms and murex to receive trade and other data feeds, process them, save into the system, and send acknowledgement. Use a combination of MXMLExchange, MXopenconnect, Murex APIs, and Datamart to successfully deliver such solutions.

 Contribute to functional documentation of the test cases and use cases by the client.

 Contribute to Design documentation for the Build process of the Product.

 Develop and maintain end-to-end configuration management packages etc. Install, Deploy and test Murex packaged interfaces like MDIT (market data interface tool), Markitwire, BSMT and MarkitCredit to receive live and end-of-day data from external providers like Bloomberg, Reuters, Markit, etc.

o Handle support cases from notification to resolution and validation.

• Participate in the business as usual and project support: follow-up of client open cases through email, CRM portal, phone-calls and on-site visits

• Develop an understanding of ongoing activities and manage own deliverables / progress

• Manage bug fixes and enhancements with the Product Team

3. Integrate with various teams to deliver the right solution to client.

o Work with S4C stream leads, Front-Office, Back-Office, or Risk teams to understand requirements and develop solutions for the client.

o Work with the Product division team to provide them timely details on defects - how to reproduce the issue, project/client constraints, and how to validate the fix.

o Follow up with the S4C stream leads, the Project Manager, and other teams to meet deadlines and regular meetings to make sure the delivery is on time.

4. Work with technologies including SQL, Unix, and Murex proprietary standards like Murex Scripting Language (MSL), XMLF, etc. for client solutions.

o Use SQL for end-of-day report generation, STP (straight through processing) failure issues, P&L evaluation, for analyzing issues in trade feed and status Etc.

o Java programming skills are not essential but are a plus.

o Various Murex proprietary languages and formats: Data Query Language for querying in various screens in MX.3, MSL (Murex Scripting Language) for pre-trade logic, XMLF for post-trade flow processing, MxML in various contexts, etc.

o Create shell/python scripts for automation of day-to-day manual activities.

Understand requirements, analyze the problem areas of the current system and behavior of pre- trade and post-trade workflow, and integration points.

Mandatory Skills Description:

Must:

- 4+ years experience with Murex Datamart and workflows

- Must know any 2 of the following technologies: MxMLExchange, RTBS/MDCS, Datamart, C2.0 Product interfaces

- SQL; XML; MxML; UNIX; Scripting languages

- Hands on experience with Murex MxML Exchange development

- Knowledge of pre trade framework along with MSL scripting language

- Strong Knowledge of SQL/RDBMS technology

- Knowledge of XML/JSON and related technologies (XSLT), Java/J2EE, Python, or C/C++ or C#, and scripting languages such as UNIX Shell or JavaScript, Jenkins, CI/CD, DevOps, Maven, Git/Bitbucket, Apache Camel, ESB, ETL

- Familiarity with UNIX/Linux operating systems

- Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills

- Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter

- Possess good verbal and written communication skills

- Must have strong organization skills

- Previous Experience in Murex Integration (MxML/WF) experience

- Strong Knowledge of SQL/RDBMS technology

- Familiarity with UNIX/Linux operating systems

- Strong DataMart Murex knowledge is a must

- Rigorous attention to detail

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- Understanding of Test management

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor – Full-Time)

Candidates must apply with an online portfolio in order to be considered.

WHO YOU ARE

You’re a highly creative, socially fluent designer who knows how to make people stop scrolling. You understand how content performs across platforms like TikTok and Instagram and know how to turn ideas into visuals that feel native, authentic, and viral.

You’re fluent in visual storytelling — from layouts and typography to repurposing video stills or designing carousels that tell a story. You think about content as part of a bigger narrative, not just a single post. You love collaborating with others, working fast, and iterating based on feedback.

WHAT WE NEED

ODDITY is seeking a Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor) to join our Growth Marketing and Organic Social team as we launch a new brand under the ODDITY portfolio.

This role will help define how the brand looks and feels across social media — shaping everything from post design to campaign visuals and creator-led content. You’ll translate ideas into cohesive, scroll-stopping creative that drives engagement, conversation, and brand awareness. We’re looking for someone who’s deeply tuned into social trends, understands the balance of storytelling and aesthetics, and can bring a strategic eye to organic social design.

Note: Our team works EST hours, and candidates should be available during standard business hours.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design a variety of assets for organic and paid social , including carousels, post graphics, stories, and light video edits
  • Help establish the visual identity for a new ODDITY brand , ensuring consistency and cohesion across platforms
  • Partner with marketing and creative teams to interpret briefs and bring ideas to life in visually impactful ways
  • Repurpose and adapt content for different social formats and trends
  • Collaborate closely with copywriters, growth leads, and creators to build assets that feel fresh, social-first, and culturally relevant

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design for marketing or social media
  • Proficient in Figma, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator (After Effects or Premiere a plus, but not required)
  • Strong eye for layout, typography, and visual hierarchy
  • Proven ability to design for social performance — balancing brand polish with native, engaging formats
  • Basic familiarity with AI design tools and interest in emerging creative technologies
  • Strong attention to detail and time management
  • Excellent communication skills and openness to collaboration and feedback
  • Impressive work ethic and willingness to work in a fast-paced and high-growth environment
  • Full written and spoken English proficiency

BONUS POINTS

  • Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram aesthetics and trends
  • Experience supporting brand launches or rebrands

WHO WE ARE

ODDITY is a consumer tech company that builds and scales digital-first brands to disrupt the offline-dominated beauty and wellness industries. Using data science, AI, and tech innovation, we serve over 40 million users through personalized product experiences.

ODDITY owns IL MAKIAGE and SpoiledChild, and is now building its next breakthrough brand — launching soon.

With headquarters in New York City, an R&D center in Tel Aviv, and a biotechnology lab in Boston, ODDITY operates at the intersection of tech, science, and creativity. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and impact-driven — ideal for those who thrive on building from the ground up.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:

As responsabilidades de UI/UX Designer incluem:

  • Conceber, prototipar e validar soluções digitais;
  • Garantir a usabilidade, acessibilidade e a estética visual do produto;
  • Trabalhar com forte domínio da ferramenta Figma e dos princípios de UI/UX aplicados ao contexto de SaaS (Software as a Service);
  • Documentar todo o SaaS (Software as a Service) da Vedius;
  • Desenhar todas as novas funcionalidades da Vedius.

Requisitos:

  • Superior completo em Design Gráfico, Design de Interação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em UX (User Experience)/UI (User Interface) Design (Desejável);
  • Certificações em Design Thinking, Lean UX, Nielsen Norman Group (NN/g), ou cursos avançados de Figma/Prototipação (Desejável);
  • Experiência comprovada como UI/UX Designer, trabalhando especificamente em produtos SaaS (Software as a Service) ou plataformas complexas;
  • Domínio Absoluto do Figma: Criação e manutenção de Design Systems, componentes, auto-layout, variantes, prototipação avançada e colaboração em equipe;
  • Fundamentos Sólidos de UI/UX para SaaS (Software as a Service): Profundo conhecimento em arquitetura da informação, usabilidade, acessibilidade (WCAG - Web Content Accessibility Guidelines), e padrões de design de interfaces web complexas (gestão de dados, dashboards, fluxos de trabalho);
  • Prototipação e Testes: Capacidade de criar protótipos de alta e baixa fidelidade e planejar/conduzir testes de usabilidade (remoto/presencial);
  • Pesquisa de Usuário: Experiência em métodos de pesquisa (entrevistas, surveys, análise de dados) para fundamentar decisões de design;
  • Conhecimento em Metodologias Ágeis: Familiaridade com Scrum e/ou Kanban e a integração do design no ciclo de desenvolvimento (handoff eficiente);
  • Ferramentas de Handoff e Documentação: Experiência em documentar especificações de design para equipes de engenharia;
  • Comunicação Efetiva: Habilidade para apresentar e defender soluções de design de forma clara e convincente para stakeholders técnicos e não-técnicos;
  • Empatia e Orientação ao Usuário: Forte capacidade de se colocar no lugar do usuário e garantir que o produto resolva problemas reais;
  • Colaboração: Excelente trabalho em equipe com Desenvolvedores, Gerentes de Produto (PMs) e outros Designers;
  • Pró-atividade e Autonomia: Capacidade de gerenciar o próprio tempo e tomar iniciativas para identificar e resolver problemas de usabilidade;
  • Flexibilidade e Resiliência: Adaptação a mudanças rápidas de escopo e recebimento construtivo de feedback;
  • Portfólio online robusto que demonstre projetos de UI/UX em produtos complexos (de preferência SaaS - Software as a Service), com ênfase no processo de design e resultados alcançados;
  • Conhecimento básico de HTML (HyperText Markup Language)/CSS (Cascading Style Sheets)/JavaScript para entender as limitações e possibilidades técnicas (Desejável);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise de dados (Hotjar, Google Analytics, Mixpanel, etc.) para análise comportamental (Desejável);
  • Experiência prévia na criação de ilustrações, motion graphics ou micro-interações (Desejável);
  • Fluência em Inglês (leitura e escrita, principalmente para documentação e comunicação com times internacionais) (Desejável).

Outras informações:

title: Cyber Security Manager (Blockchain & Tokenization)
description:
Security Manager

Location: Americas, Remote

About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.

Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!

Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on security leader who can build, manage, and scale Pointsville’s security and compliance programs. This role is ideal for someone capable of designing enterprise-grade security programs, engineering security tools, and embedding best practices into fast-moving development environments.

What You’ll Do

Security Strategy, Leadership & Program Development

  • Build and lead Pointsville’s global security and compliance function from the ground up.
  • Develop and implement the company-wide security strategy, policies, and frameworks aligned with business and regulatory goals.
  • Conduct organization-wide risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and incident response exercises.
  • Drive security awareness and training programs to strengthen company-wide accountability.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure security goals align with organizational priorities.

Technical Security Engineering

  • Lead the design and development of advanced security testing and monitoring platforms, including distributed fuzzing systems and validation frameworks.
  • Conduct secure architecture reviews and threat modeling for infrastructure, APIs, smart contracts, and cloud-native services.
  • Integrate Secure SDLC practices into CI/CD pipelines — automating vulnerability discovery, testing, and compliance reporting.
  • Perform deep-dive analysis of vulnerabilities, exploits, and mitigations across web, mobile, and blockchain systems.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to ensure secure-by-design implementation in infrastructure-as-code and deployments.

Cloud, Infrastructure & Data Protection

  • Oversee cloud security architecture (AWS preferred), including network segmentation, IAM, and continuous monitoring.
  • Manage VPNs, multi-region access, and secret management tools (Vault, KMS, etc.).
  • Ensure data privacy and protection measures are embedded in all systems and products.
  • Lead investigations, containment, and response in the event of security incidents or data breaches.

Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Develop and maintain security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA.
  • Prepare and manage internal and external audits and certifications.
  • Identify, document, and mitigate enterprise security and compliance risks.
  • Establish a “privacy by design” and “security by default” culture in collaboration with legal and product teams.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Serve as the main point of contact for all internal and external security and compliance matters.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Operations to align security controls with business needs.
  • Deliver clear reporting and recommendations to leadership on security posture, incidents, and ongoing improvements.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, product security, or infrastructure security roles.
  • Proven track record designing and deploying security tools and frameworks at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cryptography, secure protocols, and key management systems.
  • Expertise in AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of application security (OWASP, STRIDE, TARA) and vulnerability mitigation.
  • Proficiency in one or more system languages (Java, C, C++, Rust, Go) and one scripting language (Python, Shell).
  • Experience with blockchain and smart contract security preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate security controls, conduct penetration testing, and perform design reviews.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in written and spoken English

We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

  • All Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) artifacts (Terraform/CloudFormation templates).

Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Energy Management Systems (EMS) Specialist who wants to learn and transform his career

In this role you will:

  • Implement, configure, and maintain EMS platforms for real-time monitoring and control of generation units and transmission assets.
  • Support generation control, frequency and voltage regulation through EMS functionalities.
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on EMS software to generation and transmission environments.
  • Act as a middle between the client and the EMS development team and check if EMS customizations/applications are following the technical specification.
  • Provide technical support and training to operational and engineering teams.
  • Validate EMS data model.
  • Collaborate with SCADA system teams for proper integration.
  • Adjustment of network and generation applications (in run time).
  • Create a valid DTS (Dispatcher Training Simulator) model and test DTS events with the customer.
  • Analyze operational data to identify opportunities for optimizing generation dispatch, transmission flows, and system efficiency.
  • Provide support to project teams by assisting with troubleshooting, application data modeling, and implementing effective solutions.
  • Maintain and organize project documentation, including technical reports and drawings.
  • Provide training to users and operators as needed.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

title: Engenheiro elétrico
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) Eletricista Sênior experiente para se juntar à nossa equipe. O profissional será fundamental na concepção, desenvolvimento, implementação e manutenção de projetos e sistemas elétricos complexos, garantindo a eficiência , segurança e conformidade dos nossos produtos e operações.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Liderar o projeto e detalhamento de sistemas e instalações elétricas (baixa, média e, se aplicável, alta tensão) para novos empreendimentos ou melhorias.
  • Desenvolver e revisar especificações técnicas , diagramas unifilares , layouts e documentação de engenharia.
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida de projetos elétricos, desde a concepção e viabilidade até a comissionamento e entrega .
  • Realizar cálculos elétricos complexos, incluindo dimensionamento de cabos, proteção, curto-circuito e coordenação de isolamento.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas técnicas nacionais (ABNT, NRs) e internacionais (IEC, IEEE), e regulamentações do setor.
  • Coordenar e fiscalizar a execução de serviços de instalação e manutenção, assegurando a qualidade e o prazo .
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (Engenharia Civil, Mecânica, Produção) e fornecedores .
  • Propor e implementar soluções para otimização de energia e redução de custos operacionais.

Requisitos Necessários

  • Formação Superior completa em Engenharia Elétrica.
  • Experiência comprovada de, no mínimo, 10 anos em projetos e/ou manutenção de sistemas elétricos industriais ou de infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento sólido em normas e padrões (ex: NBR 5410, NBR 14039, NR 10).
  • Proficiência em softwares de CAD (ex: AutoCAD, EPLAN) e ferramentas de simulação/cálculo elétrico (ex: ETAP, PSCAD).
  • Habilidade em leitura e interpretação de diagramas e desenhos técnicos.
  • Competências: Liderança, proatividade, excelente comunicação interpessoal e capacidade de resolver problemas.

title: Salesforce Administrator (Part-Time)
description:
We are looking for a part-time, remote Salesforce Administrator with 3-5 years of Salesforce administration experience to join our U.S. client's team. You will work 10 to 15 hours per week supporting the ongoing development, configuration, and management of Salesforce across the Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Service organizations. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, a keen analytical mind, and the ability to drive business outcomes through platform optimization and insightful data analysis.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).

Responsibilities

  • Partner with cross-organizational teams to gather requirements and deliver scalable solutions
  • Administer and maintain the Salesforce environment, ensuring data integrity, system stability, and optimal performance
  • Configure, customize, and maintain Salesforce objects, fields, workflows, validation rules, page layouts, and other settings to support business processes
  • Develop and maintain Salesforce Flows, reports, and dashboards to provide actionable insights and improve user productivity
  • Design and implement new features or system enhancements
  • Manage integrations between Salesforce and third-party platforms, ensuring data consistency and seamless functionality
  • Conduct testing, troubleshooting, and documentation for new configurations, automation, and system updates
  • Monitor and manage user accounts, roles, permissions, and security settings in accordance with company policies
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices; recommend improvements and lead adoption of new capabilities
  • Provide user support, training, and documentation for more effective system usage

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 3-5 years of experience as a Salesforce Administrator in enterprise, B2B environments
  • Proficiency in Salesforce setup and configuration
  • Solid understanding of CRM principles and Salesforce best practices
  • Experience in Sales Cloud and Salesforce Flow development, reporting, and dashboard creation
  • Experience with integration tools and third-party platforms
  • Ability to review, design, and test new features and customizations independently
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Commitment to continuous learning as well as staying current with platform updates
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, business, or a related field
  • Certification as a Salesforce Administrator or Sales Cloud Consultant

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members on client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Oracle Cloud Field Service consultant
description:
Job Specification: Oracle Cloud Field Service Consultant

Contract Role – Remote

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud Field Service (OFS) Consultant to support the design, configuration, optimization, and ongoing enhancement of our field service operations. This is a remote contract role suited for someone with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Field Service Cloud, with additional experience in Oracle Service Cloud (OSvC) and Oracle CPQ being highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the implementation, configuration, and customization of Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) to support business workflows, scheduling, routing, and mobile field operations.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable functional and technical solutions.
  • Configure OFS modules including capacity, activity management, work order orchestration, routing plans, and mobility experiences.
  • Integrate OFS with other Oracle cloud applications, especially Oracle Service Cloud , Oracle CPQ , and external systems via REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Perform solution testing, UAT support, documentation, and knowledge transfer to internal teams.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring seamless field operations.
  • Recommend best practices and continuous improvements in field service processes.
  • Support deployment activities, including data migration, configuration promotion, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including service operations, IT, product management, and vendors.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) .
  • Strong understanding of OFS architecture, configuration frameworks, APIs, message scenarios, routing, and capacity planning.
  • Experience designing workflows, activity types, and policy configurations in OFS.
  • Ability to write and interpret OFS API integrations, business rules, and extensibility scripts.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements and convert them into actionable configuration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery environments.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Desired Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with Oracle Service Cloud (RightNow/OSvC) configuration, workflows, and integrations.
  • Experience with Oracle CPQ (quoting workflows, commerce rules, integrations).
  • Understanding of broader Oracle CX Cloud architecture and integrations.
  • Experience with mobile workforce or field service applications outside Oracle.
  • Knowledge of cloud integration tools (OIC, Boomi, MuleSoft, etc.).

title: Product Designer
description:
About the Company

Hi, we’re Actabl. We’re providing better solutions for hotel companies as the world around us evolves and changes related to using technology, finding labor, and maximizing profits. Our mission is to empower the people that power hospitality. We give hoteliers actionable insights to know what to do, the tools to do it, and the visibility to know it worked. We bring together powerful hospitality tech solutions to maximize profits for more than 10,000 properties in hospitality markets around the world.

Our Valued Behaviors

  • Start with People: We are in the hospitality business and hospitality starts with people. This impacts both our being and our doing.
  • Being: We are responsible for building relationships, earning trust, and having fun. These things are fundamental to hospitality.
  • Doing: We will succeed if we start with great people working as one team. Empower others, speak the truth with care, and go together.
  • Demand Integrity: Be trustworthy, be ethical, and be consistent whether someone is watching or not. Demand integrity of yourself and others to build the fabric of a high-integrity organization.
  • Delight the Customer: We aim to delight our customers in the same way our customers aim to delight their guests. The question is not if completed a process or hit a metric, the question is whether or not the customer is delighted.
  • Champion Innovation: We compete in the game of change and win through innovation. Think big and then think bigger when it comes to the innovation required to tackle the problems our customers face daily.
  • Make it Happen: We show up prepared, care about the details, and follow through. Don't get distracted. Don't stop at blockers. Don't make excuses. Find a way and drive until it is done.

About Actabl's Product Design Team

We redefine expectations

We treat SaaS with the same passion and craft you’d expect from world-class consumer products. Our mission is to redefine what hospitality teams can expect from their tools by delivering thoughtful, high-quality experiences and pushing the product forward step by step, with real impact.

Bellhop Design System

Our young design system is called Bellhop because it was inspired by the essence of hospitality. It's a scalable and cohesive system made to empower people who power hospitality. Check out .

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end design across features and flows, from discovery to delivery.
  • Collaborate with PMs and engineers to shape problem spaces, define requirements, and validate solutions.
  • Design intuitive, scalable interfaces for enterprise SaaS products with heavy use of dashboards, complex data tables, and operational workflows .
  • Run user interviews, synthesize insights, and convert them into actionable design decisions.
  • Produce high-quality UI/UX deliverables: journeys, wireframes, flows, high-fidelity screens, prototypes, tables, dashboards, etc.
  • Work closely with our design system team to maintain consistency and push our standards forward.
  • Advocate for user experience and influence decision-making across cross-functional teams.
  • Incorporate AI tools, Vibe Coding, and rapid prototyping into your process to increase velocity and quality.
  • Understand our products, personas, their journeys, and JTBD.

You as a Product Designer

Ideal Profile

You are not a “by the books” Product Designer and have at least 3 years of experience, strong design craft, and excellent communication skills. You are comfortable with high-density enterprise SaaS interfaces such as dashboards and data grids, and you work confidently with design systems and cross-functional teams.

  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Designer (UX/UI) in tech or SaaS companies.
  • Portuguese and English is mandatory
  • Living in Brazil.
  • Strong product thinking, ability to break down complexity, understand constraints, frame problems, and propose pragmatic solutions.
  • Excellent English communication (major stakeholders are native english speakers)
  • Solid experience designing for enterprise SaaS applications.
  • Comfortable crafting elegant high-density interfaces.
  • Experience working with design systems (tokens, components, libraries).
  • Strong craft with an attention to detail.
  • Portfolio demonstrating clear thinking, strong fundamentals, and high-quality craft.'

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI prototyping tools (e.g., Figma Make, V0, Claude Code).
  • Experience integrating AI into design workflows.
  • Familiarity with hospitality, operational tools, or B2B workflows.

Work Environment:

Location: Full-remote Brasil.

Connectivity: Requires a reliable internet connection and a suitable home office setup.

Equipment: The company provides necessary equipment (laptop, monitor, peripherals).

Travel: Occasional travel may be required. A valid driver's license may be required for travel.

Work Hours: Employees are expected to be available during core business hours to ensure collaboration with team members and stakeholders.

Communication: Regular communication via video calls, chat applications, and email is expected.

Additional Information

  • Full-remote job position
  • You will be hired as a contractor (PJ)

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others. 

Who you are 

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package 
  • Paid Time Off 
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are looking for a high-performing Full Stack Engineer with strong experience in both Python (backend) and React (frontend) to join our client’s distributed engineering team in Brazil. This role is ideal for someone who excels at building clean, scalable APIs and intuitive user interfaces while collaborating with product, design, and engineering stakeholders.

You will be responsible for developing end-to-end features, improving system architecture, and supporting the evolution of a modern tech stack powering mission-critical applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Python (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • Develop responsive, user-friendly front-end applications using React, Typescript, and modern UI frameworks.
  • Implement RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs and integrate them with internal and external systems.
  • Work closely with product managers and UX/UI designers to translate requirements into high-quality code.
  • Optimize performance across front-end and back-end components.
  • Manage databases and data models (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, etc.).
  • Contribute to overall system architecture, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
  • Write automated tests (unit, integration, end-to-end) to maintain code quality.
  • Collaborate in an agile environment with remote teams across Brazil.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–7+ years of experience as a Full Stack Engineer or Software Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python and popular backend frameworks (FastAPI preferred, Flask, Django).
  • Professional experience with React and Typescript (Hooks, Context, Redux, or similar).
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs or GraphQL services.
  • Strong understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases.
  • Experience deploying applications using cloud services ( AWS, GCP, or Azure ).
  • Solid grasp of software architecture, design patterns, and version control (Git).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment with clear communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized deployments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI).
  • Exposure to microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with testing frameworks (PyTest, Jest, Cypress, etc.).
  • Experience working with Brazilian or international distributed engineering teams.

title: Data Research Analyst
description:
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 3-5 years of data analysis and reporting experience
  • Advanced experience writing and creating large-scale surveys (QuestionPro, Qualtrics), analyzing results/data, and developing actionable findings
  • Experience with Tableau for data visualization
  • Experience in writing detailed reports and presenting data findings/analysis.

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Passion for video games/gaming in order to assist in writing and interpreting survey questions
  • Experience with SQL writing data queries
  • Snowflake or Data Bricks experience

Insight Global is hiring a Data Research Analyst to support the User Experience Research team at a leading company in the Gaming industry. The main role of the Data Research Analyst will be to create, send, and analyze large-scale surveys intended to learn about the player base of the core gaming products.

Job Functions

-Create surveys and trackers to support all products and initiatives

  • Design questions that do not bias respondents
  • Use best practice methodologies to produce actionable, accurate, and representative data.

-Advanced, survey focused, data visualizations (Tableau, Excel, Sheets)

  • Creating clear reports and dashboards based on surveys sent to players and users of their products.

-Data queries (HIVE, Snowflake, Tableau)

  • Querying multiple types of databases and plugging data queries directly into tools like Tableau are essential for this role. These skills will be used to target audiences for survey sends, pull in additional analytics to identify respondents, and allow for advanced data visualizations.

-Report writing and presenting data

  • Writing detailed and understandable reports that will speak to a variety of audiences across the enterprise
  • Presenting data in meetings and providing additional relevant context where applicable.

-Act as backup for all functions of current data researchers

-Provide support to UX researchers on report creation that involves data visualization.

-Quickly pivot with new data to ensure a constant flow of player insights are output as updated player survey data is received to ensure we are always reporting on timely and relevant findings.

-Contribute to overall needs of the UXR team e.g. peer review, supporting other teams with survey expertise, etc.

-Contribute survey expertise to assist others in the company with the creation of surveys.

description:

Na Infornet, nós usamos tecnologia para ajudar quem mais precisa, quando mais precisa.

  • Evoluir nossas soluções com código limpo, escalável e bem testado;
  • Participar das decisões técnicas e ajudar a encontrar a melhor forma de entregar valor;
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com pessoas de produto, design, backend e frontend;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria de processos e boas práticas da equipe.

Procuramos uma pessoa com experiência prática, que já entrega com autonomia, mas quer ir além.

Alguém curioso, colaborativo, que se importa com o que entrega e que busca crescer como referência técnica dentro do time.

description:

Como Coordenador/Supervisor Fiscal da Torre de Faturamento, o profissional será responsável por liderar a operação fiscal vinculada ao faturamento da empresa (“torre” de faturamento), assegurando o correto processamento de notas fiscais, apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos, cumprimento de obrigações acessórias, e a entrega de resultados por meio de KPIs.

Espera-se perfil de liderança, domínio técnico e capacidade de interface executiva (internamente com Financeiro, Faturamento, Contabilidade, Comercial, e externamente com clientes). O inglês avançado será requisito para interação com equipes globais ou clientes internacionais.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar as atividades da torre de faturamento: emissão e conferência de notas fiscais (saídas/entradas), conferência de faturamento, retenções, XML, NFS-e/NF-e, CTe, etc.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de obrigações acessórias: SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, DCTF, EFD-Contribuições, REINF, ECF/ECD, etc;
  • Implantar e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da operação fiscal/faturamento (por exemplo: % de notas com erro fiscal, tempo de processamento, custo por nota, índice de credits fiscais aproveitados, SLA de faturamento, conformidade) e reportar à liderança executiva;

  • Experiência comprovada em faturamento ou faturamento tributário (emissão de notas fiscais, retenções, faturamento em operação com produtos/serviços) e liderança de equipe;
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito) – para reportes, interface com clientes estrangeiros;
  • Perfil forte de liderança, com habilidades executivas — comunicação clara, capacidade de influenciar, visibilidade junto à diretoria, visão de negócio;

title: DevOps Sênior
description:
A Privacy é a maior rede social de conteúdo digital da América Latina. Nascemos para conectar tecnologia ao poder criativo das pessoas. Somos um organismo vivo, onde cada pessoa é uma célula pulsante de abundância, liberdade e autorrealização.

Aqui, performance tem propósito, estrutura tem calor humano e ambição anda junto com ética.

Nosso produto é uma rede social líder em monetização de conteúdo no Brasil, em plena expansão internacional. Esse crescimento exige um(a) Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) com mentalidade de engenharia, foco em automação, observabilidade e resiliência — capaz de operar e evoluir ambientes críticos, distribuídos e de larga escala.

Responsabilidades

Administração, Observabilidade e Operação

  • Projetar e operar ambientes altamente disponíveis, escaláveis e resilientes em AWS e Azure .
  • Construir e manter SLOs, SLIs e SLAs , garantindo confiabilidade alinhada ao negócio.
  • Implementar práticas completas de observabilidade (métricas, logs, tracing, dashboards, alertas).
  • Monitorar, diagnosticar e corrigir incidentes em tempo real.
  • Participar ativamente de on-call , garantindo resposta rápida e eficaz a incidentes críticos.

Automação, Infraestrutura e Deploy

  • Criar automações de provisioning, deploy, monitoramento e testes (Python, Go, Bash ou Node.js).
  • Desenvolver pipelines de CI/CD com rollback seguro e validações robustas.
  • Operar e gerenciar containers em Docker, Kubernetes, ECS, EKS e AKS .
  • Implementar infraestrutura como código com Terraform , CloudFormation ou Pulumi.

Arquitetura, Resiliência e Segurança

  • Realizar tuning básico em bancos SQL e NoSQL, garantindo confiabilidade e desempenho.
  • Configurar redes: DNS, rotas, firewalls, VPC, load balancing e componentes essenciais.
  • Aplicar políticas de segurança (IAM, RBAC, hardening e conformidade).
  • Conduzir testes de caos, cenários de falha, DR e resiliência.
  • Criar ferramentas internas que aumentem eficiência e reduzam débito operacional.

O que valorizamos

Mentalidade de engenharia e automação: eliminação de tarefas manuais e criação de soluções escaláveis.

Capacidade analítica e orientação a dados: decisões guiadas por evidências.

Colaboração multidisciplinar: integração com Engenharia, Segurança, Arquitetura e Produto.

Clareza na comunicação: essencial em ambientes críticos.

Autonomia, resiliência e priorização: atuação madura em cenários de pressão e alta complexidade.

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida operando ambientes críticos e de alta disponibilidade.
  • Domínio em AWS e Azure .
  • Experiência com Infra as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi).
  • Containers e orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes, ECS, EKS, AKS .
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
  • Observabilidade: Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace .
  • Conhecimento em redes (DNS, TCP/IP, VPC, firewalls, protocolos).
  • Noções sólidas de bancos relacionais e NoSQL.
  • Scripts e automações (Python, Go, Bash ou Node.js).
  • Vivência com incidentes, RCA estruturado e práticas modernas de SRE.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de missão crítica (fintech, pagamentos, e-commerce, telecom).
  • Conhecimento em Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS ou SNS.
  • Práticas avançadas de Zero Trust e segurança em nuvem.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas distribuídas e event-driven.
  • Certificações relevantes (AWS, DevOps, Kubernetes, Azure).
  • Participação em programas estruturados de on-call.
  • Contribuição para a comunidade (open source, artigos, palestras).

Modelo de contratação e ambiente

  • Contratação: PJ
  • Local: Presencial — Zona Sul de São Paulo/SP
  • Ambiente colaborativo, com cultura forte, liberdade técnica e foco em inovação.
  • Estrutura horizontal, com autonomia para propor, testar e evoluir soluções.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico (para CNPJs ativos há pelo menos 6 meses) ;
  • Cartão Caju;
  • TotalPass;
  • Estacionamento conveniado;
  • Ambiente dinâmico, com alto nível técnico, aprendizado contínuo e impacto direto no negócio.

Por que entrar na Privacy

Estamos evoluindo e ampliando nossa infraestrutura para suportar o crescimento acelerado da plataforma.

Como SRE, você terá impacto direto na confiabilidade, segurança, escala e eficiência dos sistemas que atendem milhões de usuários.

Se você busca um ambiente técnico desafiador, com autonomia e cultura de engenharia madura, essa é a oportunidade ideal.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant

Remote – Brazil

*Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.

Company Overview

Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.

Position Overview

As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  2. Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  3. Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  4. Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  5. Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  6. Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  7. Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  8. Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  9. Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.

Qualifications

  1. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  2. Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  3. Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  4. Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  5. Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  6. Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.

Preferred Experience

  1. 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  2. Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  3. Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  4. Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  5. Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  6. Strong English Skills.

Benefits:

  1. Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  2. Flexible work environment.
  3. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

Sobre a Consorciei

Desenvolvemos plataformas whitelabel e soluções com IA generativa que trazem eficiência às administradoras e uma experiência digital completa para os clientes — do momento da compra até o pós-venda.

⚙️Sobre o produto:

Estamos lançando um novo produto de cobrança com IA generativa para recuperação de clientes do consórcio, elevando a taxa de recuperação, eficiência operacional e experiência do cliente.

  • Plataforma de cobrança conversacional com IA generativa para contato ativo e passivo e negociação com clientes em atraso (1–3 parcelas);

  • Painéis de performance, experimentação (A/B) e régua de cobrança configurável.

Missão do cargo:

Liderar a evolução e o sucesso do produto de cobrança com IA da Consorciei, desde discovery até scale-up, garantindo adoção pelas administradoras, performance de recuperação e experiência superior para clientes finais.

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Conduzir entrevistas e acompanhamentos com administradoras e clientes finais, mapear jornadas, desenhar régua de cobrança e experiências conversacionais seguras e eficazes;

  • Realizar demonstrações para administradoras, apoiar propostas, POCs e pilotos;
  • Liderar implantação, parametrização de regras de negociação/régua, monitorar resultados, criar playbooks e suportar equipes das administradoras;
  • Comunicar progresso, riscos e decisões; promover alinhamento e transparência;
  • Estabelecer SLAs, métricas de confiabilidade, gestão de incidentes e documentação do produto.

Requisitos obrigatórios pra vaga:

  • PO/PM em produtos digitais, preferencialmente fintech, bancos, meios de pagamento ou crédito;
  • Vivência em produtos B2B ou B2B2C, com integrações via APIs e implantação em clientes enterprise;

  • Experiência com discovery, priorização por impacto, escrita de user stories e condução de squads ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);

  • Excelente comunicação e escrita;

✨ Diferenciais:

  • Alta capacidade analítica - capaz de entender o impacto na cadeia de suprimentos, identificando tendências, padrões e oportunidades que podem influenciar a tomada de decisões e dia-dia da operação
